name: @relay/mcp
description: Relay stdio MCP server: bundled by esbuild (with the MCP SDK) into packages/plugin/dist/mcp.mjs (DESIGN.md §2.2, §9).

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=../plugin/dist/mcp.mjs --minify --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __relayCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __relayCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
